items.title: Exploring Un-Adulting as Adults Seek to Be Kids Again
items.snippet: Expedia's Unpack '27 report finds 57% of travellers plan to book an "Un-Adulting" trip by 2027, prompting hoteliers to consider nostalgia-themed stays and adults-only playground resorts.

items.title: Expedia’s $676 Million in Acquisitions Points to More B2B Buying
items.snippet: Skift Take: Expedia’s 2026 deals are a fraction of the nearly $6 billion it spent in 2015. But three acquisitions in nine months, plus CEO Ariane Gorin’s pledge to keep investing, signal that Expedia is a buyer again. And B2B is where the money is going.

items.title: Washington Dulles Opens Its First New Concourse in Nearly 20 Years
items.snippet: Washington Dulles opens its $745 million Concourse E with 14 United Airlines gates, a massive new lounge and improved passenger facilities, as the airport undertakes an ambitious $20 billion redevelopment program.

items.title: Cruises, glamping, Parc des Princes: loyalty now leaves the room
items.snippet: Long reserved for hotel nights, loyalty points are finding new uses. Hilton opens them up to Explora Journeys cruises and AutoCamp camps, while Accor converts them into a day on the Parc des Princes pitch, alongside the PSG legends.

items.title: Ballard Pier Opens Mumbai’s Integrated Cruise Lifestyle Destination
items.snippet: The Ballard Pier Downtown Experience Centre has opened on Mumbai’s eastern waterfront, bringing the Mumbai International Cruise Terminal together with dining, retail, fashion, design and leisure experiences. Envisioned by the Mumbai Port Authority and operated by J M Baxi Ports & Logistics, the destination was formally inaugurated on October 23, 2026, by Mumbai Port Authority Chairman Shri Dr M.

items.title: Air Canada Drops Mumbai Service, Air India adds Non-stop Flights
items.snippet: Air Canada will not restore its Toronto Pearson–Mumbai service in 2027, leaving the Canadian carrier without a connection to India’s financial capital. The airline had operated the route through London Heathrow, using fifth-freedom traffic rights to carry passengers between the UK and India.

items.title: Meliá Hotels International expands Bangkok portfolio with two hotels, marking ME by Meliá’s Asia debut
items.snippet: Meliá Hotels International has expanded its presence in Thailand with the addition of two hotels in Bangkok’s Sukhumvit district, paving the way for the Asian debut of its luxury lifestyle brand, ME by Meliá, and further expansion of its flagship Meliá Hotels & Resorts brand.

items.title: India Relaxes Passport Rules for Select Foreign Nationals
items.snippet: The Ministry of Home Affairs has amended immigration rules to extend exemptions from passport and travel document requirements to several categories of foreign nationals residing in India, including certain Pakistani citizens, minority communities from neighbouring countries, registered Sri Lankan Tamil refugees and Tibetans.

items.title: HP: Tourism employees' union, BJP opposes proposed PPP transfer of Peterhoff
items.snippet: The Himachal Pradesh government faces a plea from the Tourism Corporation Employees' Union regarding Hotel Peterhoff. Union general secretary Raj Kumar emphasised the hotel's capacity to generate significant revenue. Concerns are mounting about a potential transfer to private management via a Public-Private Partnership model, igniting criticism from BJP members who highlight the hotel's historical significance.

items.title: Chiang Mai Cancels Flights Ahead of Lantern Festival
items.snippet: Chiang Mai International Airport in Thailand has announced 108 flight cancellations and schedule changes to another 80 services ahead of the annual Yi Peng and Loy Krathong festivals. The operational adjustments will remain in place from November 21 to 28, 2026, as authorities prepare for an estimated 200,000 sky lanterns and smoke balloons expected to be released during the celebrations.
